approvers: Tax adviser, lawyer, wife, house bank of the buyer
reason: A free confidential meeting costs me nothing, and staff, name and site in writing is what I care about. But I am handing over my life's work to a firm with no track record, so I will only sign after my adviser has checked them thoroughly.
objection: They have no earlier sellers and no references. Who are these people really, and will my 22 staff and my customers still be looked after in three years?
instead: Keep the business listed on nexxt-change and talk to a broker, trade buyers or a management buyer at around EUR 375,000, or keep working a few more years.
would_change_my_mind: Meeting the directors in person, my adviser confirming the structure and the bank letter, and a reference from a seller or a long-held business they already run.
